paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Error rate for slots
model_annotation: The pie chart displays the distribution of error rates across various categories. There are eleven slices representing different types of errors, including “size,” “name,” “genre,” “to,” “from,” “intent,” “time,” “date,” “location,” “city,” and “destination.” The slices are colored in shades of orange, green, and yellow; “size” represents approximately 4.20%, “name” represents 5.20%, “genre” represents 13.50%, “to” represents 14.50%, “from” represents 17.00%, “intent” represents 3.80%, “time” represents 4.10%, “date” represents 19.30%, “location” represents 3.80%, “city” represents 2.60%, and “destination” represents 3.00%.  Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and every segment appears to be ordered from smallest to largest in terms of area.
